import json,sys,base64
from datetime import datetime
from pydantic import TypeAdapter, ValidationError
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from apps.api.routers.governance import _encode_history_cursor as enc, _decode_history_cursor as dec
from fastapi import HTTPException
out={}
cur=[]
for iso,i in [("2026-03-01T12:00:00.123456","abc"),("2026-03-01T12:00:00","id-é"),("2026-03-01T12:00:00+00:00","x"),("2026-03-01T12:00:00+05:30","x")]:
    dt=datetime.fromisoformat(iso); cur.append({"iso":iso,"id":i,"cursor":enc(dt,i)})
out["encode"]=cur
def b(o): return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(o,separators=(",",":")).encode()).decode().rstrip("=")
dec_in=[enc(datetime.fromisoformat("2026-03-01T12:00:00.5"),"a"),enc(datetime.fromisoformat("2026-03-01T12:00:00+05:30"),"a"),
 b(["2026-03-01","a"]),b(["2026-03-01T12:00:00Z","a"]),b(["20260301T120000","a"]),b(["2026-03-01 12:00:00","a"]),b(["2026-03-01T12:00:00.1234567","a"]),
 "!!!","","AAAA",b(["2026-03-01T12:00:00",1]),b(["2026-03-01T12:00:00"]),b({"a":1}),b("x"),b(["nope","a"]),b([1,"a"]),b(["2026-03-01T12:00:00","a","b"]),
 base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b'\xff\xfe').decode()]
d=[]
for c in dec_in:
    try:
        t,i=dec(c,"audit event"); d.append({"cursor":c,"ok":True,"time":t.isoformat(),"id":i})
    except HTTPException as e: d.append({"cursor":c,"ok":False,"detail":e.detail})
    except Exception as e: d.append({"cursor":c,"ok":False,"detail":"PANIC "+type(e).__name__})
out["decode"]=d
ta=TypeAdapter(datetime)
ins=["2026-03-01","2026-03-01T12:00:00","2026-03-01T12:00","2026-03-01T12:00:00Z","2026-03-01T12:00:00z","2026-03-01 12:00:00","2026-03-01t12:00:00","2026-03-01_12:00:00","2026-03-01T12:00:00.5","2026-03-01T12:00:00.123456789","2026-03-01T12:00:00.1234567891","2026-03-01T12:00:00+05:30","2026-03-01T12:00:00+0530","2026-03-01T12:00:00-05","2026-03-01T24:00:00","2026-02-30","2026-03-01T12:60:00","2026-03-01T12:00:60","1700000000","1700000000.5","1700000000000","  2026-03-01  ","","garbage","2026-3-1","20260301","2026-03-01T12","2026-03-01T12:00:00+24:00","2026-03-01T12:00:00+23:59"]
p=[]
for s in ins:
    try:
        t=ta.validate_python(s) if False else ta.validate_strings(s) if False else ta.validate_json(json.dumps(s)) if False else ta.validate_python(s)
        p.append({"in":s,"ok":True,"iso":t.isoformat()})
    except ValidationError as e:
        x=e.errors()[0]; p.append({"in":s,"ok":False,"type":x["type"],"msg":x["msg"]})
out["time"]=p
json.dump(out,open(sys.argv[1],"w"),indent=1,ensure_ascii=False)
